verses.html: A Song of degrees. Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
verses.text: A Song of degrees. Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
verses.title: A Song of degrees.

verses.html: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.text: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

verses.html: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.text: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

verses.html: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
verses.text: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.

verses.html: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.text: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

verses.html: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
verses.text: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
